answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring staked vouching for new identities. A newcomer must collect endorsements from established agents who lock collateral behind each vouch, slashed if the newcomer misbehaves. This turns trust into a scarce resource: a whisper of suspicion makes sponsors cautious, so mass fake accounts find no backers. Regular liveness checks keep a pulse on activity, revoking idle or duplicated identities, preventing isolated ivory clubs of fake agents from validating each other without outside stake.
